lines.en: Kwame, this street is so busy now. Life was slower here when I was young.
lines.pt: Kwame, esta rua está tão movimentada agora. A vida aqui era mais lenta quando eu era jovem.

lines.en: Was it quieter than today? I see a big crowd on every sidewalk.
lines.pt: Era mais calma que hoje? Vejo uma grande multidão em cada calçada.

lines.en: Much quieter. There was less noise and fewer cars, so the air was cleaner.
lines.pt: Bem mais calma. Havia menos barulho e menos carros, então o ar era mais limpo.

lines.en: But was life simpler then, or harder than now?
lines.pt: Mas a vida era mais simples naquela época, ou mais difícil que agora?

lines.en: Harder in many ways. Work was longer, and we didn’t have as many machines as now.
lines.pt: Mais difícil em muitos aspectos. O trabalho era mais longo, e não tínhamos tantas máquinas quanto agora.

lines.en: And shopping? Was it cheaper than today?
lines.pt: E as compras? Eram mais baratas que hoje?

lines.en: Yes, it was. The grocery on the corner was smaller, but the food was fresher and cheaper.
lines.pt: Eram. O armazém da esquina era menor, mas a comida era mais fresca e mais barata.

lines.en: I think life was simpler, but also more tiring.
lines.pt: Acho que a vida era mais simples, mas também mais cansativa.

lines.en: True. People were poorer than now, but they helped their neighbors more.
lines.pt: Verdade. As pessoas eram mais pobres que agora, mas ajudavam mais os vizinhos.

lines.en: That’s interesting. Do you think the pace of life was better then?
lines.pt: Interessante. Você acha que o ritmo de vida era melhor naquela época?

lines.en: I think it was more peaceful, but I like my phone and my warm house now.
lines.pt: Acho que era mais tranquilo, mas gosto do meu celular e da minha casa quente agora.

facts.label: Comparativos no passado
facts.sub: Use was/were + adjetivo-er ou more + adjetivo: harder, quieter, more peaceful. Fewer + plural, less + incontável.

facts.label: mais …
facts.sub: Use -er com adjetivos curtos: harder, quieter, cleaner, cheaper, fresher. Para y no fim, mude para ier: easy vira easier, happy vira happier.

facts.label: mais …
facts.sub: Use more com adjetivos longos: more peaceful, more tiring, more interesting. Nunca use more com -er: more easier está errado.

compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “mais difícil”, “mais calmo”, “menos barulho”.
compare.us: Em inglês, adjetivos curtos usam -er: harder, quieter, cleaner. Adjetivos longos usam more: more peaceful, more tiring. Para contáveis, use fewer cars; para incontáveis, use less noise. No passado, use was ou were.

solo: Peça uma experiência pessoal do aluno com essa diferença.
group: Leia as duas colunas e peça que apontem a maior diferença.

extra90: Dupla: um fala como no Brasil, o outro como nos EUA.

pages.title: A street in Miami · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a hot afternoon in Miami. Pam and Paulo walk along a busy street. Old houses stand next to new towers. Music comes from a window. Pam stops at a small corner. She wants to tell Paulo a story.

“Paulo, this street is so busy now. Life was slower here when I was young.” says Pam. “Was it quieter than today? I see a big crowd on every sidewalk.” says Paulo. “Much quieter. There was less noise and fewer cars, so the air was cleaner.” says Pam.
